name: What interior maintenance updates are recommended for home accessibility?

mainEntity.name: What interior maintenance updates are recommended for home accessibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior maintenance for accessibility focuses on modifying physical spaces to ensure safety and independence. Common projects include widening doorways through finish framing adjustments, lowering thresholds between flooring transitions, reinforcing bathroom walls with blocking for secure grab bars, and repairing uneven tile floors to eliminate trip hazards. These updates protect residents with limited mobility while preserving the structural integrity and aesthetic flow of the living area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key updates include reinforcing walls for grab bars, smoothing out floor transitions, widening interior doorways, and eliminating loose or uneven floor tiles.
